purpose: Render resolved official source and evidence references into clear citizen-facing citations without exposing internal investigation machinery.
core_principle: WHY_THIS_CLAIM → OFFICIAL_SOURCE → EXACT_SUPPORT → DATE/VERSION → LIMITATION IF ANY
presentation_rules: Use plain language for why a source matters.
Keep the source identity precise enough for independent checking.
Show the relevant section, rule, judgment or record identity where known.
Show temporal information when it affects applicability.
Separate official source from CICAN explanation.
Do not expose internal chain-of-thought, dependency graph details or confidence scores.
Do not imply that a source establishes facts outside its actual scope.
link_rules: Prefer the authoritative official source or official retrieval route.
For property-specific records, link the official service route rather than exposing restricted personal information.
A route link may explain how to obtain evidence; it is not itself evidence of the property fact.
hard_stops: No citation without a resolved source record.
No citation that materially overstates the source.
No historical citation without temporal verification where time matters.
No property-specific citation from a general source.
No hidden limitation that changes what the citizen can rely upon.
